notes.title: Update #8: v1.867
notes.notes:
This small update includes the following changes:

 auto targeting can be disabled in the options menu: you have to assign a targeting key to your controls by first pressing the RESET TO DEFAULT button, then you can use the assigned button to lock on the target ahead of your ship
 saving options in the in-game menu
 fixed: in some rare cases the tutorial "throttle up" was not triggered correctly

Thank you for the feedback!

notes.title: Update #4: v1.856
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce the latest update and exiting Early Access with the following changes:

 missions game mode: 4 additional missions (single player & multiplayer)
 survival game mode: two survival levels (single player & multiplayer)
 custom game mode: two custom battle levels (single player & multiplayer)
 HTC Vive virtual reality headset support
 new networking lobby system
 handle up to 12 controllers / joysticks
 new laser sound
 improvements in visuals and performance
 bug fixes

Thanks a lot for the community for the feedback! We know that not every wish or request was implemented but we've tried to address the most important issues. In some other cases we had to choose side. We are still open for bug reports and feature requests as if the game prospers on Steam we tend to continue adding features.

notes.title: Update #3: v0.771
notes.notes:
This update includes the following changes:

 performance improved on all missions!
 mouse sensitivity range expanded, now the mouse can be calibrated to be less sensitive
 horizontal thrusters: ability to strafe left and right
 fixed hull and shield values on co-op client players
 fixed ship repairing when docked on co-op client players
 single player mission achievements won't trigger in multiplayer game mode
 starting spawn point fixes in co-op mode
 mission 6: capital ships movement fixed
 mission 5: cyclops hull balance tweaked
 mission 2: mission end timer tweaked

notes.title: Free DEMO and early access release date
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the free demo version of Starway Fleet. Please download, test and give your feedback in the relevant sub-forum.

Check out the new teaser taken from the demo.

The early access version will be available for purchase on 25-07-2017, so 2 weeks to go ;)
